title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette and a pause/play time animation to the Session 3 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 3 app marks waiting people in red and safe designs in green, which some colour-blind users cannot tell apart, and the time slider must be dragged by hand.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette plus text labels that stay readable in grayscale in light and dark mode, and a Play button that advances the time slider.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Safe and unsafe designs distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Play/pause works with the keyboard
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: people are not all the same
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet: every person starts at the same moment and walks at the same speed.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Real drills show a wide spread of pre-movement times; design values are high percentiles.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: draw the floor plan
body:
## Problem
Session 3 builds only one shape of building; real plans have rooms, corridors and stairs in different places.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A plan-file reader, shortest-route exit choice and the Session 3 simulation running on any small plan.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The roadmap checkpoint is met and shown in a figure
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a stair plan checked against ASET, including a blocked stair
body:
## Problem
The Target compares 1.5 x RSET with ASET for eight stair designs; there is no public planning tool that takes a plan and occupants and prints such a report.

## Context
The full planning tool behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus a figure like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] RSET 316 s with two 1.2 m stairs and 512 s with one blocked, for the Target settings
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
